newsitem.title: USA: U.S. candidates end debate with different visions.
newsitem.headline: U.S. candidates end debate with different visions.

text.p: President Bill Clinton and Republican challenger Bob Dole concluded their first public debate on Sunday with Clinton saying he has done his best to guide America's fortunes while Dole said he has ideas that are better.
"I've done my best to be faithful" to the duties of office, Clinton said in his concluding remarks. Dole, saying he has a different vision, declared: "I know where I want to take America."
